nodes.prompt: Repo: seo (Avada SEO Suite Shopify app; Firebase Functions in packages/functions/src, React/Polaris v13 in packages/assets/src; jest 24 from repo root `npx jest ` — jest 24 cannot resolve `node:*` imports, so a test must jest.mock (with a factory) any module that pulls in puppeteer, @elastic/*, cheerio; jest's shared transform has no JSX, see packages/assets/src/helpers/checklist/__tests__/modalBackendError.test.js for compiling a JSX module with transformFileSync; eslint 6 needs env DISABLE_V8_COMPILE_CACHE=1). Branch: FAL-837 shop SEO checklist redo. Read the brief first: /Users/nguyentuan/Documents/second-brain/jobs/2026-10-08-seo-image-alt-es-templates.md (Why + Decisions are binding). HARD RULE for packages/functions: never write `await import(...)` of a local module — .babelrc keeps import() native and Node throws ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND in prod (jest hides it). Lazy-load with require(). Shopify bulk export JSONL: with nested connections each child is its own line carrying `__parentId`; read how handlers/jobDataMigrate.js and the chunk processing (services/jobDataMigrate.service.js) consume the export before changing the query. Bulk queries carry routing markers (`#bulkElasticsearchExport...`) — never drop one. i18n: translations under packages/assets/src/locale/translations/*.json are generated by `yarn update-label`, which needs an API key you do not have. For each new key add it to the component's own JSON (e.g. ChecklistItem's json / the Issue json the existing Issue.checklist.emptyImageAlt keys live in — find it with grep) AND add a real translation to all 14 translation files (da de en es fr it iw nb nl origin pt-BR sv vi zh-CN), editing only the lines you add, keeping each file's formatting. TASK image-alt-details — round 2 of the Image alt item. Read the brief's "Round 2" section (binding). Your tree already has round 1: ES imageCount/missingAltCount/templateSuffix, artifacts/templatePages.js (pickTemplatePages, countHtmlImages, default export), htmlPageContent.fetchAllWithFetch + fetchWithTimeout, issues/emptyImageAlt.js, assets components/Issue/ChecklistItem/TemplatePageRows.js. 1. Fetch outcome: fetchWithTimeout returns {html, status, reason} (reason: 'rateLimited' for 429, 'httpError' other non-2xx, 'password' when the final URL is /password, 'network' on abort/connect error; null on success). 429 → retry up to 2 more times with 2s then 6s backoff, honoring Retry-After (seconds) capped at 10s; make the sleep injectable so tests do not wait. logger.warn('[fetchWithTimeout]', shopId, url, status|reason) on every non-success. Keep fetchAllWithFetch's existing callers (htmlPageContent default export without timeout) behaving the same — check their use of the return value. templatePages pages carry {status, reason} when not checked; the password-store early return sets reason 'password'. 2. Missing images: - Product export: add `image { url }` inside `... on MediaImage`. transformDocument stores `missingAltImages` (array of image URLs whose alt is missing, max 10) on product/collection/article docs; collections/articles use image.url. Keep imageUrl. - listStoreIssuePages: add `missingAltImages` to _source and return it on rows as `missingAltImages` (only for emptyImageAlt rows is fine, or always — keep it simple). - countHtmlImages also returns `missingAltImages`: src of each counted with no alt attribute, resolved to absolute against the page URL (handle protocol-relative //cdn.shopify.com), prefer src, fall back to data-src / first srcset URL, deduped, max 20. - EmptyImageAlt.audit: also return `resources: [{pageType, title, url, image, missingAltCount, missingAltImages}]` — the first 5 resources with missing alt — read by a new ES query (reuse listStoreIssuePages with type emptyImageAlt, limit 5, or a small helper in storeScan; it must be an artifact input, i.e. extend the storeResources artifact or add an artifact, don't query ES inside the audit). storeResources null → no resources. 3. Frontend, components/Issue/ChecklistItem/: for emptyImageAlt, inside the expanded Collapsible render ONE container with TWO sub-cards (Polaris Box with border + borderRadius + padding, or Card, stacked with BlockStack gap) — replace the current PageTypeRows + TemplatePageRows output for this item only (other items unchanged): (a) "Product, collection & blog images": line "{missing} of {total} images missing alt" (from failedCount/scannedCount, or the success sentence when 0); up to 5 resource rows: Thumbnail size small (ImageIcon fallback), title as external link to url, the url shown as subdued text, "{count} images missing alt", then the missing images as small Thumbnails (each wrapped in a Link to the image url, external). Footer: "View all" Button variant plain → onOpenPages for the item (existing modal flow, check PageTypeRows for how onOpenPages is called with a pageType) — if the modal needs a pageType, show one View link per page type that has failures, like PageTypeRows does. (b) "Site & template pages": one row per templatePages entry: label (Homepage, or "{Type} · {template}" with Default for default), full url as external link text, then either "{missing} of {total} images missing alt" + thumbnails (Link to src) of missingAltImages, "All {total} images have alt" when 0, or the not-checked reason text per reason: rateLimited "Shopify temporarily blocked our request (429). Rescan later.", httpError "The page returned HTTP {status}.", password "Your store is password protected.", network "The page did not respond in time.". The pages modal rows (hooks/modal/useModalChecklistPages.js) for emptyImageAlt show the missingAltImages thumbnails under the row (small, max 10). Keep the modal's existing structure and tests passing. Move TemplatePageRows into the new layout (rename/replace freely; delete what becomes unused). Use Polaris components and existing Avada-ChecklistItem classes; add SCSS in ChecklistItem.scss only if needed (no inline margins). Long URLs must truncate/wrap without breaking layout (word-break) — keep rows readable at 360px width. All new strings → issue.json (Issue.checklist.emptyImageAlt.*) + all 14 locale files, real translations. Tests: fetchWithTimeout reasons + 429 retry (injected sleep, Retry-After cap), countHtmlImages missingAltImages (relative, protocol-relative, data-src, srcset, dedupe, cap), transformDocument missingAltImages, EmptyImageAlt resources passthrough, a render test of the two sub-cards (compile JSX with transformFileSync like modalBackendError.test.js / TemplatePageRows.test.js). Rules: touch only files in the contract allow list. TDD: failing test first, watch it fail. Comments say WHY only (a constraint, a Shopify limit, a unit), never narrate WHAT; no step numbering, no banners. Backend logging via @functions/helpers/logger with [fnName] + shopId, never console.*. No secrets, no new dependencies (cheerio is already a dependency — check packages/functions/package.json), do not touch .env*, lockfiles, .gitlab-ci.yml. Run every verify command yourself and format with `DISABLE_V8_COMPILE_CACHE=1 npx eslint --fix ` (the pre-commit hook rejects prettier errors). Final message: file:line per change, what you removed, and anything in the brief you could not do and why.
